message.content:
Tests pass now.

**Root cause:** In `duration.go`, the `units` map had `'m': time.Second`. The `'m'` unit should mean minutes, so `45m` was being parsed as 45 seconds and `1h30m` as 1 hour + 30 seconds.

**Fix:** Changed the mapping to `'m': time.Minute`.

The error-handling cases (`""`, `"1h30"`, `"h"`, `"10y"`) still return errors correctly, so no other changes were needed.
